description: Create and publish surveys, quizzes, and forms; manage projects and responses; analyze results and generate reports in WebAsk.

commands: claude mcp add --transport http webask https://mcp.webask.io/mcp/v1 --header "Authorization: Bearer $WEBASK_API_KEY"

notes: api-key; send the required Authorization request header with a Bearer token from the user's own WebAsk API key. Create the key under Settings > API / MCP in WebAsk.
